''See also: [[Visiri Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Visiri are a superhuman species characterized by red skin and three eyes. Their central eye is distinct from their primary pair, as it possesses the unique ability to perceive life energy rather than infrared light or Aetheric flows. While they generally possess a weaker connection to the [[Aether]] compared to other intelligent species, they are renowned for their mastery of [[Combat Arts]] and their immense physical strength, with warriors capable of damaging starship plating with their hands. Physically, they are unable to survive in environments lacking an atmosphere. The Visiri inhabit the [[Visiria system]], which serves as a major component of the [[Karoshan Alliance]]. As the second most significant power within this alliance, their territory includes several planets and a fleet of crimson-striped ships that provide significant reinforcement capabilities. The political landscape of their home includes a High [[Council]], a [[Planetary Governor]], and various military or security forces. Public opinion regarding the group known as [[The Last Horizon]] is split among the Visiri, with some viewing them as heroes who defended the system from invasion and others seeing them as unstable threats.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Members of this species possess scarlet skin and three eyes. One eye is specifically designed to monitor energy and vitality.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|These superhuman beings utilize energy pools to achieve levitation, produce concussive bolts, and generate red auras. They are high-level Combat Artist{{!}}Combat Artists and skilled flyers who possess enough physical strength to tear through starship armor with their bare hands.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Captain}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Following the discovery of [[Horizon]] by a Visiri explorer last week, this scarlet-skinned species with three eyes has emerged as an opponent.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c8">''The Captain'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c11">''The Captain'', chapter 11</ref> The Visiri are capable of using energy pools for hovering, concussive bolts, and empowerment, while their warriors are skilled flyers who can tear through starship armor with their bare hands.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c14">''The Captain'', chapter 14</ref> Despite their physical prowess, the species tends to possess a weaker connection to the [[Aether]] than other intelligent life forms.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c17">''The Captain'', chapter 17</ref> Notable individuals include the muscled, pale pink-skinned [[Reaver]] and the [[Visiri man]] [[Raion Raithe]], as well as the powerful warrior serving as the narrator.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c13">''The Captain'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c20">''The Captain'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c21">''The Captain'', chapter 21</ref> Other encounters involve Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax defeating a Visiri pistol duelist and the presence of Denon Javal, who is half-Visiri.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c12">''The Captain'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c35">''The Captain'', chapter 35</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Blade Dancer]] is a woman of the Visiri species.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c8">''The Engineer'', chapter 8</ref> As a type of being, the Visiri possess high levels of physical strength.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c11">''The Engineer'', chapter 11</ref> The Alliance includes a small number of planets inhabited by the Visiri.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c34">''The Engineer'', chapter 34</ref> Despite their strength, these beings are unable to survive in environments lacking an atmosphere.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c37">''The Engineer'', chapter 37</ref> Currently, Visiri men are in the process of holding [[Jak Escalon]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c43">''The Engineer'', chapter 43</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Knight}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As one of the five species of intelligent beings in the galaxy, the Visiri are a group of people and fighters who serve as high-level Combat Artist{{!}}Combat Artists.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8">''The Knight'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12">''The Knight'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c30">''The Knight'', chapter 30</ref> These universally superhuman opponents are fought in the [[ring]] and utilize swords and spears for dueling.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c36">''The Knight'', chapter 36</ref> The Visiri make up the majority of the crowd in their own capital and represent the clear number two within the [[Karoshan Alliance]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c13">''The Knight'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c33">''The Knight'', chapter 33</ref> Physically, the species possesses three eyes, including a third eye specifically designed for watching energy and vitality.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c25">''The Knight'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28">''The Knight'', chapter 28</ref> Although they are not known for their magical scanners, the crew intends to disable this group.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c35">''The Knight'', chapter 35</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c36" />}}
